_comment: English body for prompt-case-test-cases. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output a test-case table covering normal, boundary and error inputs; do not claim execution.
Inputs: Requirements, input domain, and existing tests.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Generate test cases for {requirement}. Output cases[] with id, type (normal/boundary/error), input, expected and rationale. expected must follow from the requirement; mark undefined behaviour instead of guessing. List coverage_gaps[].
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.检查点:
- All three types exist or gaps are explained.
- Expected results link to requirements.
- Undefined behaviour is not guessed.
sections.失败分支:
- Duplicate cases: merge by input domain.
- Vague requirement: mark undefined_behavior.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.

sources: OpenAI Cookbook: Introduction to Structured Outputs (official repository raw, fetched 200 on 2026-11-07)
